title: tracktx pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for nascent RNA analysis (PRO-seq, GRO-seq).
$comment: Every top-level param nextflow.config sets a default for is listed here (nf-schema's validateParameters() otherwise warns on any it isn't -- confirmed by running with -preview and reading the WARN list it printed, then adding each one). additionalProperties stays true as a safety net for a per-dataset params.yaml flag not covered here (11 dataset configs under results/ each carry their own overrides) -- a genuinely new param degrades to silently passing through rather than a hard failure blocking a real run. The ~25 flags a user actually types (samplesheet, reference_genome, etc.) get real type/enum/required checks; the power-user nested maps (align/norm/qc/pol/replicates/umi/barcode/adapter_trimming/output/advanced/functional_regions/res, ~100+ entries combined) are declared as bare `type: object` so their internal keys stay unconstrained rather than requiring a second schema to track their internal knobs in lockstep. Main.nf's own hand-written checks remain the source of truth for conditional business rules (e.g. reference_genome=other requiring custom_genome_id) that a static schema expresses far less clearly than a plain error message.

reference_genome.description: Reference genome ID (e.g. hg38, mm39) or 'other' for a custom genome.

sample_source.description: Where input reads come from: local FASTQ files or SRA accessions.

library_type.description: Assay type; controls R1 strand handling at alignment (see nextflow.config for details).

spikein_genome.description: Spike-in genome ID, or 'other' for a custom spike-in genome. Optional.

genome_fasta.description: Custom genome FASTA path. Required when reference_genome=other.

spikein_fasta.description: Custom spike-in genome FASTA path. Required when spikein_genome=other.

custom_genome_id.description: Short, unique name for a custom genome. Required when reference_genome=other; used as the cache/output directory name so distinct custom genomes never collide.

custom_spikein_id.description: Short, unique name for a custom spike-in genome. Required when spikein_genome=other, same reasoning as custom_genome_id.

annotation_exclude_biotypes.description: Comma-separated gene biotypes to exclude from the gene catalog (e.g. rRNA,tRNA).

annotation_chr_naming.description: Chromosome naming conversion: none, add (Ensembl->UCSC), or remove (UCSC->Ensembl).

control_label.description: Condition label used to auto-select the siCPM normalization control (module 08).

assets_dir.description: Persistent artifact storage directory (genome/annotation caching across runs).

genome_cache.description: Internal download cache directory for genomes/annotations.

publish_mode.description: Nextflow publishDir mode. Use 'copy' for exFAT/USB/NAS drives where hard links fail.

force_rebuild.description: Force re-execution of cached download/index-build steps.

help.description: Print the pipeline's usage message and exit.

conda_norm.description: Override conda env for the normalization module.

conda_pol.description: Override conda env for the polymerase-metrics module.

conda_divergent.description: Override conda env for the divergent-transcription module.

conda_fgr.description: Override conda env for the functional-regions module.

conda_sra.description: Override conda env for the SRA download module.

experiment_name.description: Free-text label for this run, shown in reports.

revcomp_r1.description: Override: reverse-complement R1 before alignment. Null = auto-derive from library_type.

signal_end.description: Override: which read end defines downstream signal. Null = auto-derive from library_type.

reports_plots.description: Verbosity of extra diagnostic plots in per-sample reports.

fastq_gzip.description: Compress downloaded SRA FASTQs with pigz.

sra_tmp.description: Temp directory for fasterq-dump. Null = system default.

sra_max_size.description: Max prefetch size for SRA downloads.

sra_cache_dir.description: Override: directory for the raw-FASTQ SRA resume cache, kept off the results drive.

publish_sra_fastq.description: Publish downloaded SRA FASTQs into results (vs. hidden cache only).

preprocess_reads_lenient_cache.description: Use lenient Nextflow cache mode for the preprocess step (set true for NFS/network storage).

publish_trimmed_fastq.description: Publish trimmed FASTQs into results (~900MB/sample if enabled).

publish_alignments.description: Publish alignment BAMs into results (~270MB/sample if enabled).

publish_references_gtf.description: Publish the full GTF into references output (~790MB if enabled).

adapter_trimming.description: Adapter-trimming options (enabled, preset, adapter1, adapter2, minlen).

qc.description: QC thresholds/options for module 13 (mapq, dedup, fail_map_rate_below, fail_strand_min, ...).

umi.description: UMI handling options (enabled, length, location, dedup_allmap).

output.description: Output track format toggles (cpm, crpmsi, raw_tracks, bigwig, bedgraph).

norm.description: Normalization options for module 08 (emit_bw, emit_sicpm, emit_allmap, emit_5p).

pol.description: Pol-II metrics options for module 11 (contrasts, top_n, plots, tss_win, body_offset_min, body_offset_frac, min_body_frac, min_body_len).

functional_regions.description: Functional-region window sizes for module 10 (tss_active_pm, prom_up/down, tes_down, enhancer_up/down).

res.description: Auto-detected CPU/memory allocation map (see nextflow.config); not user-facing.

replicates.description: Replicate-merging options for module 05b (merge, concordance_min, concordance_method, concordance_bin_size).

counts_allow_index_build.description: Allow module 07 to build a missing BAM index itself.
